recipes.title: The Answer — espresso
recipes.notes: The roaster states each quantity as its own window; the pairing of a particular dose with a particular yield is the barista's, not the roaster's.

recipes.title: French press, scaled to your press
recipes.notes: A small press may take 25 g to 375 g of water, a large one 45 g to 675 g. The ratio holds across the window, which is what couples the two ranges.
